methodology.eventModel: competing Poisson scoring hazards with player-specific matchup redistribution
playerInputs: recent head-to-head scoring and shot form
matchupInputs: last-10 overall goals and shots allowed
verified starting-goalie prior + recent save rate
attacking-team last-30 and last-10 scoring/shot creation
methodology.selection: Top 3 and Risky Value are selected only after matchup-adjusted FGS and ATG probabilities are calculated.
methodology.riskyPick: One additional player per team chosen outside the top three for a combination of long verified odds, matchup-adjusted model probability and price-vs-model edge.
methodology.note: Sportsbook markets remain the anchor. Position, venue, recent-defense, team-offense, rest, goalie, H2H and usage factors are sample-shrunk and capped so small samples cannot overwhelm market and player-history evidence.
